document: Extend EU Settlement Scheme for those affected by Covid-19, To apply for the EU Settlement Scheme citizens must usually have started living in the UK by 31 December 2020. However, unforeseen issues linked to Covid such as the travel ban on arrivals from South Africa prevented EU citizens from entering the UK, meaning they are ineligible for this scheme., The Government should extend the date by which EU citizens must have started living in the UK in order to be eligible for this scheme, and also extend the deadline for applying, so that EU citizens affected by Covid-19 restrictions are not prevented from accessing this scheme.

Make face masks compulsory for secondary pupils and school staff in classrooms, The WHO make it clear that face coverings should be worn where social distancing of 2 metres cannot be ensured. , There is strong evidence that face coverings can reduce the transmission of the virus to others. There is NO evidence for the Government's position that masks should be avoided because they may interfere with communication and learning. 

Make face coverings compulsory for secondary pupils in class and communal areas immediately.

Make Smoking Illegal In All Public Places, Smoking is already illegal in workplaces and enclosed public spaces, but this should be extended to all public places. Although taxes on cigarettes provide valuable public funding, people die every day of secondary smoking This is why I am asking the government to ban smoking in all public places., My grandfather died of lung cancer. He did not smoke, but he worked with a smoker; he essentially died from secondary smoking. When I leave my house I find people leaning against my home, smoking. You may think there is nothing wrong with that, but by smoking near others, they are forcing us to smoke, as inhaling smoke has similar effects as smoking. This is unacceptable. So I ask the government to make it illegal to smoke in all public places.

Make wearing face masks mandatory., Make it mandatory for everyone (except  for those with valid medical reason)to wear face masks once outside their homes to prevent spread of covid virus., To prevent the spread of the covid virus.

Include Cabin Crew as frontline staff and prioritise for Covid 19 vaccine, Include Airline Cabin Crew as frontline staff and key workers and give us a higher priority to be vaccinated for the Covid 19 vaccine due to the nature of the job., Cabin Crew are still catching Covid 19 due to insufficient testing of passengers to and from different destinations due to different rules in other countries where restrictions are not as strict as they should be. This then leaves us with a loss of earnings and puts those of us in high risk categories or who have family members who are high risk at risk of the virus. If we are vaccinated along with other frontline staff this will reduce the problem.

Vaccinate Keyworkers e.g Supermarket Staff, Bus Drivers.., The government need to take into account that Bus Drivers, Supermarket Staff and more keyworkers have been putting their own health and families at risk working during the pandemic. They deserve to be protected to and have been forgotten about. We come into contact with more people than anyone., The government should be protecting all that have been risking infection day in day out outside of a medical background. We all matter.

Make Teachers and Supermarket Assistants high priority groups for COVID vaccine, These two groups have become forgotten about in this pandemic- the general public acts as though these groups are immune to COVID because they work in the front line too- I think our hard work through multiple lockdowns must be recognised, feeding and educating the nation one day at a time, Put teachers and school employees such as cleaners and caterers, and any person who works in a supermarket, into the top priority groups for COVID vaccinations

Require all cafes to close during national lockdown, including for takeaway, We believe that coffee shops are not essential and as such should not be able to open under lockdown measures, even for takeaway services. Allowing coffee shops to open means members of the public are going out and getting a coffee, when this is not an essential journey., Under the lockdown restrictions across the UK, when non-essential shops are forced to close, cafes should not be allowed to open for takeaway services under these restrictions. It’s not right to risk the lives of workers and their families just so someone can have a warm beverage.

Prioritise early years workers for receiving Covid-19 vaccinations, The UK is once again in national lockdown in order to control the spread of Covid-19. While schools and workplaces are closed, early years settings have remained open, providing a vital service to working parents and enabling our youngest children to continue learning and receiving care., Young children are not able to socially distance and the nature of the work requires close contact and intimate care, while at the same time wearing PPE is not recommended. Early years workers are at high risk and deserve the protection afforded by early vaccination, in order that they can continue the vital work that they do.

Make it a legal requirement for taxi drivers to wear face masks., I would like the government to make it a legal requirement for all taxi drivers to wear a face mask., I am a carer for vulnerable people in a nursing home and I rely on taxis to work. The taxi drivers are not wearing facemasks and I don't feel safe. I am afraid that I will catch coronavirus from one of them. The drivers can refuse to take someone if they don't wear a mask but yet the driver expects the customer to sit in their car and breathe in their germs. Scientists have already said that face masks protect others from you, so why am I protecting the drivers but they aren't protecting me?

Close the UK Border immediately to stop the spread of Covid - 19 Variants, Even today you can travel into Britain from anywhere in the world without restriction and only on advise to quarantine, which has proved useless because hardly anyone follows it.  

A the new variant has arrived from South Africa, which would not have happened had the UK closed the Border., We the British people have had enough of the non action in this area and the fact it is still being allowed at a time when people are sacrifising their freedoms to bring the virus under control. 

We the British public ask the UK government to close all airports, seaports and the channel tunnel to all but emergency travel during the Lockdown. Emergency travel must only be for things like if a family member is seriously ill abroad or UK Citizens coming back home.

Early Years should follow all other education during lockdown-not open to all!, We have lots of children in a room, we can not do our jobs and social distance properly, we can not wear PPE!
If the whole country is in a national lockdown, and all other types of education open to critical workers and vulnerable children-Early Years should be the same!, We work hard, we love our jobs!
We deserve to be given the same respect and care as other educators.
We are currently being asked to put ourselves, the families and children we care for and our own families at risk. 
During this lockdown we should be open to vulnerable children and critical workers children only.

Provide reusable face masks for everyone, The government should use public funds to give reusable face masks to everyone., A key responsibility of government is keeping everyone safe, so while we have COVID-19, they should give reusable face masks to everyone. 

We are required by government to wear masks to enter shops and pharmacies, and should be wearing masks whenever we are near other people, so they should be providing masks to everyone. 

A reusable mask costs money, but some people are too poor to afford them. This is unacceptable during a pandemic.

Prioritise Key Retail Workers, being offered the Covid Vaccine!, Prioritise the roll out of the vaccine for key retail workers! 
Supermarket workers etc.. kept the nation fed when everything else was closed. They were called ‘hero’s’ and should be high on the list of first people to receive the vaccine., Key retail workers, come into contact with hundreds of members of the public on a daily basis, putting their and their families lives at risk of contracting Covid 19. We don’t have the vast PPE that the NHS are provided with and rely on people to keep their distance and wear masks, which doesn’t always happen. 
This is a petition to demand we get faster protection for our front line key retail staff, who keep the country fed!

Close takeaways, they aren’t essential, I don’t believe takeaway services are essential, the new rules are not to leave home for non-essential reasons, takeaways are not essential, The new regulations tell people to leave their homes for healthcare, work and essential food shopping. As a McDonald’s worker, I can speak for a lot of us when I say McDonald’s doesn’t fall under any of these categories so we shouldn’t be open. It’s risking all our well being as it’s a struggle to maintain social distancing. I believe if it’s a lockdown like March, it should be a full lockdown and nobody should be in this compromising position.

Make it illegal to force employees to use annual leave to cover self isolation, Annual leave has never been more essential to for peoples mental health. You rely on your annual leave to lighten these pressures, now more so than ever in the pandemic. If you are forced to use these days for isolating you soon find your 21 day allowance halved by a 10 day isolation period., The Government needs to ensure that employees' annual leave is protected from being used unfairly, for a crisis that is out of control and is not their responsibility to take fault for. In a pandemic an employee who is isolating/protecting people from covid-19 should be praised not punished to encourage self-isolation.

Increase legal protection for lodgers (people with live-in landlords), The laws protecting lodgers need to be updated. I suggest:, 1. Define live-in landlords as landlords who spend an average of 4 nights/week at the property
2. Require landlords to notify lodgers if they will be away for an extended period of time
3. Deposits from lodgers must be placed into a deposit protection scheme.

When my live-in landlord tried to kick me out of my home for having a small bible study in the house one evening, I realised that there is next to no legal protection for lodgers in the UK.
 
I feel landlords exploit loopholes in the law to be classified as "live-in" when they are rarely there, meaning they gain all the benefits of it without the hassle of living with lodgers.
There is a huge imbalance of power between lodgers and live-in landlords and laws need updating to address this.

Limit of 25% of attendance to prioritise safety of staff and pupils in education, Limit the number of children attending educational establishments to 25% during the 'lockdown'  to facilitate safety for staff and pupils and break 'transmission' routes to the community. Prioritise keyworker  children and the vulnerable without enabling 'access for all', In initial lockdown there were restrictive measures to limit the number of school attendees. Government has instigated a 'lockdown' but has loosened the guidelines around attendance resulting in many schools being over attended whilst also providing remote learning. Instigate tight guidelines to ensure numbers are restricted as current policy is leading to more risk associated to school attendance and increasing pressure on staff. Schools are safe 'mixing of familes' is not so has to be limited

Review testing and self-isolation requirements for arrivals to England, The Government has introduced a requirement to prove a negative Covid-19 test result before departure for England. This is on top of a requirement to self-isolate on arrival when travelling from most countries. We believe this is unnecessary and unfairly imposes unreasonable costs on travellers., People travelling to England should be required to either prove a negative Covid-19 test result, or self-isolate, not both. Where testing is required the Government should ensure that tests are made available free of charge.

Specific offence of verbally abusing someone for not wearing face mask, Anyone who verbally abuses someone for not wearing a mask, where that person has an exemption card, will be committing an offence and if reported could find themselves charged with assault., Many vulnerable people and children are being victimised simply due to their inability to wear a face covering while in shops or public spaces, in some cases where those with special needs it can cause physical stress.

Create a scheme to legally recognise those exempt from wearing face masks, The UK Government should create a scheme to legally recognise those exempt from face masks with official proof of exemption. Currently it’s difficult to enforce the face mask law without proof of exemption. , This will allow those such as retail workers to challenge non mask wearing customers who aren't displaying an exemption. This will stop the people who believe that covid-19 is a conspiracy, being defiant, above the law etc. from disrespecting other customers and workers who are willing to wear masks to protect themselves and others. Personally I have had several customers feedback saying that when other customers who aren't displaying exemption and aren't wearing a mask it makes them feel exposed and vulnerable.

Make Future Lockdowns Illegal, I want any further Lockdowns to be impossible to implement because of the deaths that the shutdown causes, I think it it is unfair, that we should have to give up our freedom, over a virus that only kills old and vulnerable people.

Require University Libraries to close in lockdown, The Department for Education should require Higher Education libraries to close during lockdown. Under the latest guidelines, Higher Education libraries are permitted to open in lockdown, with no restrictions on opening hours, allowing access for hundreds of people., Allowing university libraries to remain open undermines efforts to prevent people from mixing, and is inconsistent with advice to act as if we all have the virus. To protect the NHS and each other, the Government must require University libraries close during lockdown.

Increase Statutory Sick Pay to £330 per week during COVID-19, Statutory Sick Pay to be increased to £330 per week paid to anyone in the UK who has to take sick leave or isolate during the COVID-019 pandemic, e.g. until 31 December 2021, To ensure that EVERYONE can afford to take sick leave or isolate and thus reduce the transmission of COVID-19.  This will support vaccination to ensure that transmission is held down whilst the vaccination program is rolled out.  It will also support planned asymptomatic testing programs, as the scheme in Liverpool identified that people with less financial stability were less likely to get tested, and so likely to increase transmission.

Get supermarket workers the COVID vaccine ASAP  class them as front line workers, Class supermarket workers as key front line workers to get the COVID vaccination after the health care key workers and the vulnerable . We have been in this nightmare from beginning bringing food to the nation ., So the supermarket workers are protected ASAP . We have 1000’s customers every week and not being protected is frightening. We cannot wait for 6 months .to many of us having to isolate . And putting our families at risk when we go home and not being able to see our families. We need protection so we can protect our customers..

Make the wearing of a face mask in shops and public places compulsory by law., Pass a law making it compulsory to wear a face mask in shops and public places. Failure to wear a face mask without reasonable excuse will result in a fine and the person liable to be arrested in serious cases or refusal to give their details., This virus is spreading at an unprecedented rate and still people refuse to wear a face mask and adhere to Government guidelines. Shopkeepers are being placed in an invidious position on refusing access to people not wearing a face mask and not keeping social distancing, as currently they do not have the backing of the law. Having a law making it compulsory to wear a face mask in shops and public places would allow shopkeepers to call on Police for assistance.

Make free school meals vouchers available as soon as schools close in lockdowns, In any future lockdowns, a supermarket voucher system must be operational in all areas where schools are closed, as soon as schools are closed, for families with children on free school meals. Vouchers, not food parcels, should be the default. Government guidance should be updated to require this., Schools should give parents of children receiving free school meals vouchers as the default option during lockdown, instead of food parcels from schools' catering companies. During the January lockdown there were reports that the lunches being sent in a lot of cases amount to little more than £5 of the £15 allocated for food and that taxpayers are being charged. With vouchers parents can get much more to actually feed their children properly.

Permit any international travel for anyone testing negative for Covid-19, I think everyone who can present a negative Covid test up to 3 days before travel should be allowed to travel internationally anywhere in the world., Relationships are been forced to become long distance and families are being kept away from each other!! People who test negative for Covid-19 should be allowed to travel internationally! 
 
Please let us fly out from the UK internationally so we can see our boyfriends, girlfriends, husbands, wives, partners, and family members!
 
Please stop this travel ban!!

Make face masks mandatory in all outdoor settings in highest Covid-19 rate areas, Make the wearing of face masks mandatory in all outdoor settings in areas with the highest rates of Covid-19 with the existing exemptions., It is extremely difficult to maintain social distance in many areas with the highest rates, and this is now more important with the new strain of Covid-19.
 
International experience has shown that making the wearing of face masks compulsory has helped to keep transmissions down. This should also make the general public feel safer. It is now more important with the new strain of Covid-19 and its prevalence in certain areas, that tighter restrictions/ preventive measures are imposed.

Ban the placing of an industrial incinerator near where I live, To stop the go ahead of an industrial incinerator near residential properties., There is a major health concern regarding this due to a significant rise in childhood asthma and deaths.
As well as the pollution it will cause it will also affect property prices in the area.
This has to be stopped.

Bring back the food vouchers instead of food hampers, We would like you to issue parents with food vouchers instead of food hampers and only the Goverment can do this and tell schools to to this., Goverment can tell schools to issue us with vouchers instead of hampers. It’s not worth the money the government are giving to schools and we only get little bit but with the vouchers we can get a lot more and we can chose what we feed our kids

Stop private firms profiteering from hungry children, Instead of the £30 voucher many parents were receiving before, they are now being sent boxes that barely contain £5 worth of food. This is nowhere near enough food to last for the school week. The contract should be taken away from these private firms and parents should be given the £30 instead., With schools closed, thousands of hungry children across Britain who usually get free school meals need other food to see them through the week. The government is paying private caterers Chartwells to provide this, but now it has come to light that their 'meal boxes' are painfully inadequate. The government should provide the £30 in vouchers to the parents so they can use them at the local supermarkets to buy sufficient food for their children.

Give out £30 vouchers to low income families for food supplies, It’s appalling of what the government has supplied for children to eat in ten days. The petty portions of food, the half peppers and onions, the small sandwich bags of pasta and rice. A parent could get so much more for £30 to fend for in ten days., Petitions after petitions to get the governments attention to deal with low income families who struggle without the free school meals for their children during this pandemic. The day after photographs of the food THEY have supplied is unacceptable for a young child to eat for TEN days. Giving vouchers of the so said £30 would benefit low income families more than the pathetic amount the government has been supplying for our children.

Provide free school meal vouchers directly to parents in need., Stop Chartwells receiving our public money in replacement of food vouchers. The quality of food parcels are absolutely dyer! Children are going hungry in this third lockdown because parents are not receiving support for their children’s food needs! And in some cases getting no food support at all., Provide food vouchers directly to parents in need! In this third lockdown.

Prioritise all asthmatics for the Covid vaccine. , I want government to add in all Asthmatics  to be in group six for the covid vaccine. Currently category six does not cover all asthmatics so many people will fall through the gaps, Have you ever struggled to breath, or collapsed and just can’t catch your breath I have on many occasions and have been hospitalised four times and take regular inhalers. Some times my Asthma is managed and then other times it hits me like a lead ballon and even just chatting I’m fighting to catch my breath, that’s on a normal day when I have a cold it is a nightmare so image if I caught covid and I’m not alone with out the vaccine we are trapped and forgotten because we fall through the cracks.

Remove contracts from School Meals Firms use local catering providers instead., Send a message that profiteering from child hunger in morally wrong and remove transgressors from any government contracts for 5 years, Because I don’t wish to live in a morally bankrupt country where our leaders have no principles and corruption appears to be the norm

Include all Supermarkets workers into  priority list to get the Covid-19 Vaccine, What I want it and definitely  the most of my colleagues wants is to get the Covid-19 vaccine in the same priority as NHS workers., We are the biggest forgotten key workers since this pandemic time has arrived. In difference with other key workers (but not taking away any importance from them) we've always been there since day 0 and will continue there until the end of this and beyond. Reviewing this we are very potential spreaders, think this, each colleague in a supermarket may deal with between 200-300 persons per day, facemask and social distancing isn't enough to keep us safe and working.

Require people in care to were face coverings when in presence of care staff, The Government should make it mandatory for people in care, who are not exempt from requirements to wear face coverings, to wear these when in the presence of care workers, and make face coverings available for this purpose., Currently you can't use public transport or walk into a supermarket without wearing protective clothing, which protects others from you. Yet care staff are expected to work closely with people in care who wear no such items, risking there lives in the process. It's simply not acceptable that such vital members of our society can be left so exposed without basic protective measures being put into place.

Define what constitutes a free school meal., Define a free school meal as a substantial and nutritious main meal., It is important for a free school meal to be defined to upload standards of meals and ensure those children in need are in receipt of at least one substantial meal a day.

Supermarket employees to be prioritised for Covid-19 Vaccine, We would like supermarket employees to be prioritised along with the vunerable, NHS staff and care staff for a Covid-19 vaccine, Supermarket employees are at risk from infection as they are in direct daily contact with the public.  Supermarkets are ideal conditions for Covid-19 to spread as not all members of the public follow Covid-19 rules such as social distancing, hand sanitisation or wear a face covering (excluding those who are exempt for medical reasons.)  Supermarket employees are at very high risk of contracting Covid-19.  We feel like the forgotten "key workers" by this government.

Provide free face masks for everyone, and free N95 masks for vulnerable people, Homemade cloth face masks are better than nothing, but they are a stopgap measure.

Provide free face masks for everyone, and provide N95 masks for vulnerable groups such as immunocompromised people, people with asthma, the elderly, etc.

This also ensures that masks are of good quality., "Why Aren’t We Wearing Better Masks?", The Atlantic, 13/01/2021. https://www.theatlantic.com/health/archive/2021/01/why-arent-we-wearing-better-masks/617656/

Quality of homemade face masks is inconsistent, and was necessary at the start of the pandemic before production was stepped up.

Countries providing free face masks to citizens (e.g. Taiwan, Singapore, Hong Kong) have a lower transmission rate.

Implement Quarantine Hotels for all UK arrivals from overseas., New strains of Covid-19 are a threat to the NHS and public health, including through people abusing the exemption for international travel as 'work purposes.' Therefore, the UK Government should do more to protect, introducing a mandatory 7-10 day Hotel Quarantine period for all UK arrivals., This 10 day period would contain mass testing and 24/7 security. All travellers would be charged for their hotel accommodation unless they can provide a valid medical exemption for not being able to self-isolate. This would also provide an income for the hospitality sector.

It may seem excessive, but considering the success of Australia & New Zealand, it is the only viable option in opening the economy back up sooner and preventing the spread of new variants from overseas travellers.

Prevent digital vaccination passports from being implemented., With vaccination against COVID-19 being well under way in the UK, the question of “digital vaccination passports” has arisen. This petition requests that parliament prevent digital vaccination passports being mandated for the access of mass gatherings, travel, hospitality, etc,, The notion of vaccination passports has invited outrage from those fighting to protect civil liberties. Silkie Carlo argues that they provide the “backbone” of an authoritarian  digital ID system, with personal information potentially being held at the fingertips of authority. Digital vaccination passports set precedents for the curtailment of privacy and free movement, a tactic diagnostic of one-party regimes like China and inexcusable in a democratic, free society.

Have an official mask exemption card that is issued via your GP., Have a Mask Exemption card that is issued by a medical practitioner only.

That is logged to one person only via their NHS number. 

This card would then be the only acceptable proof of medical exemption which would assist retailers and the police., Retail staff are still being put at risk by members of the public who do not have a genuine reason to not wear a mask.

Exemption cards can be downloaded by anyone without any proof and this system has been very much abused and used as an excuse to abuse staff.

The police would also benefit from having a tighter system when incidents arise where people are not wearing masks, when they should be.

Prioritise keyworkers (supermarket staff) for the covid vaccine., Keyworkers (supermarket staff) are customer facing and at risk every single time they go to work. We can be in close proximity to hundreds if not thousands of people per day and therefore should be prioritised alongside careworkers for receiving the covid vaccine., To make sure the uk’s supermarket staff are fully protected. A lot of us have children at school and there risk of us spreading the virus to our children and therefore to teachers. 
Although it is now law to wear a mask when in shops unless exempt we do not have the ability to confront those people that flout the rules. We are also not allowed to ask for exemption proof so people are using it as an excuse to come into store when they have forgotten their mask. This puts us all at higher risk.

Issue grants to landlords for lost rental income due to Covid-19, Government needs to make it fair for landlords! Many businesses have been able to claim generous grants, but landlords are getting NOTHING. The Government should provide landlords with a grant for loss of rental income caused by the pandemic as landlords are losing so much money., Properties are stood empty because no one can open or start a non-essential business, and many commercial and residential tenants are not paying their rent. Landlords live from the rental income and we’ve lost thousands. Grants should be given to landlords who have lost rental income, whether because of non-payment of rent, or because properties cannot be rented due to Covid-19 restrictions.

Make the G7 Summit in June virtual only, Many people will not have had the vaccine until by the time of the G7 summit. It is therefore not right, fair or guaranteed to be safe for UK politicians or those from other countries to travel to Cornwall for this conference., Unless everyone going to this Summit (from the UK and other countries) have had the vaccine (which appears unlikely) no one should be going in person to Cornwall for the summit.

Protect supermarket workers., Make it the law to wear a mask in side supermarkets.
Make Proof of exemption by a doctor must be shown if no mask is warn., Behind the NHS the supermarkets are also front line workers, workers are starting to feel scared from the lack of social distancing and attitudes towards the rules from the public.
People are treating supermarkets as a day out, so one person per trolley must be enforced and made law.
Action must be taken to protect these people and save the nhs.

Consider estate agents for the vaccine before being rolled out to all, Let estate agents work to their full capacity by allowing them to have the vaccine before it is rolled out to all. Our working environment means we are going in and out of households and our clients and agents would feel safer if we were vaccinated., So that we are safer in our working environment of mixing with households. I think all estate agents know they are not key workers but are considered essential. We are not asking to be put above anyone vulnerable or key workers but to be considered before the mass roll out to all

Make displaying a “face covering exempt” sign mandatory, for the rightly exempt, There are places where face coverings are required eg public transport /shops. Some people are rightly exempt. There is no obligation to display a sign saying that that person is exempt however. This makes it difficult to ask someone to wear a face-covering without fear of causing offence., Over 1,000 people have died of coronavirus on 20 January alone. Many of us may be vulnerable, unable to avoid entering a shop or travelling on public transport. Those who should and can wear a face covering must, and those who cannot, should feel no shame in displaying a recognised sign. If they can register to self-certify for one (or face a fine), a widely available, free of charge sign will avoid those rightly exempt from feeling judged, promote good practice, help enforcement and avoid deaths.

Introduce managed isolation at the UK border to protect against COVID variants, We call for the immediate implementation of an Australia-style managed isolation system at the UK Border. 

At a minimum, this system should include:

(i) mandatory hotel quarantine for all travellers for 14 days, and 
(ii) mandatory COVID negative tests before release., COVID variants can emerge at any time, anywhere in the world. Each new variant has the potential to be more deadly, more infectious or to evade our vaccines.

Managed isolation keeps variants at the border and prevents them from becoming established in our communities. 

An unmanaged border leaves us all open to the risk of new variants becoming established in this country, with devastating consequences to our vaccination program, our NHS and our personal freedoms.

Do not enforce mandatory hotel quarantines for international arrivals., Stop the push of mandatory hotel quarantines for international travellers. This would make reuniting families and binational couples more difficult. Implement safety through test and quarantine in a place of their choosing. Safe travel does not require stripping people of their basic human rights., The mental health of thousands is at risk if this is enforced. ‘Love Is Not Tourism’ is a movement created by thousands of people who have been living in anxiety, forcefully separated from their loved ones for over a year. With the restrictions already in place, it’s made it difficult for those to reunite but would be made even more difficult if forced hotel quarantines were put in place due to an abundance of reasons. Tests & quarantine at a place of choosing is all we ask, please do not do this to us.

Help put postal workers on NHS priority list for vaccinations against COVID 19, During this time, Royal Mail has seen a lot of sickness, self-isolations and many casualties as a result of COVID-19. We would like the government to include postal workers on the list of priority groups for vaccines., We would like the government to help the Royal Mail. We have seen many postal workers scared of coming into work because of concerns over this disease, we deliver almost every day of the week, putting ourselves at risk to give customers the service they deserve, I believe we can sustain a better service going forward if postal workers, as backed by our union, if postal workers were given the vaccine.

Adopt a Zero Covid strategy - full lockdown and close borders, A year since the first UK lockdown due to the COVID pandemic and the spread of the virus has not been controlled. 100,000+ people have died. The spread of new variants presents a risk to the effectiveness of possible vaccines. A Zero COVID Strategy is needed!, 2 key principles that should underpin the Zero COVID Strategy:
 
1) FULL lockdown planned & enforced. Hospital, care home, emergency services and UK "lights on" staff (telecoms infrastructure, etc.) the only exceptions. Financial support to those impacted.
 
2) UK border closure during lockdown. Implementation of strictly supervised "2-week" quarantine facilities with testing on entry/exit after lockdown.

Allow exemption from hotel quarantine for people travelling for medical purposes, People travelling for essential and non-deferrable medical treatments not available in the UK will be put in extreme difficulty and mental distress by enforcing hotel quarantine.  We ask for exemption, and are willing to abide by a method of location checks whilst isolating at home after arrival., To protect the public from covid spread by international travellers, whilst also protecting those travellers with extenuating circumstances from the severe physical, mental and financial distress a hotel quarantine will bring them.  This small group may also need urgent medical assistance when back in the UK. 
A better way to control the spread would be to introduce lateral flow testing on arrival in addition to having a negative test certificate as already successfuly implemented in Europe.

Free prescriptions for all asthma sufferers, Asthma sufferers rely on inhalers to be able to live and yet they are having to pay for their prescriptions. Asthma is an ongoing health condition like epilepsy and diabetes, some of whom get their prescriptions free so why don’t asthmatics get them free?, There are a lot of asthmatic people who are not able to afford their inhalers meaning they go without them and may end up becoming very ill and possibly dying. 

People who have asthma are also prone to getting chest infections as well as pneumonia which means they also have to pay for antibiotics on top of their inhalers so that they can stay alive.

Allow schools, universities, restaurants and shops to open in March, We would like the Government to reopen schools universities, restaurants and shops by March. What is the point of vaccinating the entire population if we are not willing to reopen before the season ends?, The UK economy has already contracted massively due to the measures taken by the government to combat the coronavirus. We, the people, have passively sat by and withstood being confined to our our homes for nearly an entire year as businesses suffered, unemployment rose and we actively lost an entire year of our lives to the coronavirus. Each day we remain locked down we acquire substantial debt which our children will be forced to pay. We must reopen the economy.

UK PM to publicly acknowledge police brutality towards peaceful farmers in India, Stop and withdraw from all arms and defence deals between UK firms and Indian Government and all Indian companies.  Until UK Parliament debates the matter and the British Prime Minister writes to the Indian Prime Minister and voices his concern at the tactics used against innocent farmers in Delhi., Mainstream media have observed and reported Indian Police attacks on innocent farmers in Delhi.  Many have been reported of dying during the peaceful protests.  There danger of escalation in India. There is a real concern from British-Indian community about arms and defence equipment being sold to India at this time, and that they could be used in this conflict.

Allow Pubs and Restaurant to be one of the first to reopen., With the proof that pubs and restaurants aren’t a Covid Hotspot and minimum cases, allow hospitality to be one of the first professions to re open.,
Fund free school meals for all children, Food shouldn’t cost children anything in schools and should be free regardless of wealth., This should be a basic principle.

I think you should feel the same. I feel it is my responsibility and the Government's responsibility to ensure citizens have the appropriate care they need.
 
The wellbeing and care of your citizens should be the top priority of a caring government.

Fund a programme of mass testing and public education to reduce risk of strokes, Each year there are more than 100,000 strokes in the UK each year causing 38,000 deaths, and long-term disability for many., Mass testing, and a public awareness campaign about this and the risks of strokes, could help identify people at risk of strokes and enable early treatment.

Abolish quarantine requirements when entering the UK from a non-red list country, Abolish requirements to quarantine after visiting a country which is not on red list, regardless of inoculation (vaccination) status., Studies show vaccinated persons can catch and transmit the virus, and reducing the burden on travellers should help boost morale of the population & the economy.

Ban discrimination against potential tenants on Universal Credit, I would like Parliament to pass a law to prevent landlords from refusing tenants who are on benefits and who would want to pay with UC and to fine letting agents who encourage this behaviour., I have been trying to move houses for months now. Time and time again when the landlord hears the money to pay for the rent will come from Universal Credit they don't want to have anything to do with it.
 
Many times landlords say that it is a condition of their Mortgage (which possibly discriminates against UC tenants). It shouldn't matter where the money is coming from as long as one is able to pay. Many tenants are threatened with eviction and yet it is so difficult to find suitable accommodation when one is on UC.

Ban full face coverings being worn in public, Several governments have banned full-face coverings and coverings where only the eyes can be seen in public places for security reasons. We should too, especially given the case in Dundee where 3 men have been convicted for armed robbery of a jewellers using full face coverings.,

Allow British Citizens and UK residents to quarantine in their own homes., We would like the Government to allow British citizens and UK residents entering the UK to be able to quarantine in their homes rather than in a government-approved hotel., Many British Citizens and UK residents have families in other countries around the world and have not been able to visit them since the beginning of the COVID Pandemic. Allowing for British citizens and UK residents  to be able to quarantine in their residential homes will alleviate the huge costs of hotel quarantine on return to the UK.

Require children attending school to isolate whilst waiting for a PCR result, Change the law to stop children attending nursery and school whilst waiting for a PCR test result. They should have to isolate at home until they have had the result, Relying on guidance alone is not enough to stop the spread of the virus in schools and is totally wrong. This should be a legal requirement.

Remove South Africa from the travel red list by Christmas, South Africa is once again being treated unfairly due to coronavirus. Their infection rate is significantly lower than the UK's. South Africa has a sophisticated and advanced infectious diseases infrastructure, with some of the world's leading epidemiologists working in South Africa., South Africa had the capabilities to detect new strains of COVID-19, but this does not mean that South Africa is the origin of variant, as has been portrayed by some.
 
There are hundreds of thousands of people who have not been able to see their families in years, families who have missed special occasions, missed funerals, missed moments together due to travel bans.
 
Remove South Africa from the red list by Christmas to allow families to reunite without the scandalous hotel costs.
Close all UK border to prevent COVID-19 spread, To stop the spread of the new variant.,

Home quarantine for families with under 5s arriving from red list countries, Hundreds of families are split between the UK and South Africa after already enduring 2 years apart. Families who travelled during the brief time SA was off the red list now are left having to hotel quarantine at an exorbitant cost, and to ask require of families with young children is unacceptable., Hotel quarantine for 10 full days with a toddler or baby will have a significant financial and emotional cost for many. We believe it is cruel & unnecessary to keep families with young children in a hotel room.
 
No one wants to spread the new variant but no one, especially children, should have to suffer due to hastily implemented travel bans. 
 
We live in the UK, our home is there. We shouldn’t be punished for visiting our family for the first time in 2 years.

Revoke compulsory wearing of facemasks on public transport and in shops, The recent mandating of masks should be overturned forthwith and we should return to making it a matter of personal choice whether or not to wear one., There has not been any recent spike in infections, hospital admissions or deaths, and we believe this new "omicron" variant provides no justification for extra restrictions.
 
An evidence review by the Cato Institute has concluded that clinical evidence of facemask efficacy is of low quality and the best evidence has mostly failed to show efficacy: https://www.cato.org/working-paper/evidence-community-cloth-face-masking-limit-spread-sars-cov-2-critical-review

Allow British/Irish Nationals coming from red list countries to isolate at home., We need the Government to Stop the hotel quarantining for British/Irish/EU settlement nationals. We don’t want to pay the exorbitant hotel quarantine fees and feel that we should be able to self isolate in our homes, especially when tested negative on a fit to fly PCR test., Costs of hotel quarantines are incredibly expensive, especially after saving for years to try reunite with family members. It’s not only a financial burden on many but creates a problem for those who would like to return to their place of UK residency. The hardship agreement, which should assist with these fees, is granted based on necessity but is near impossible to be granted. If the hotel quarantine is scrapped for nationals, we would be able to quarantine at home without a financial burden.

Exempt contacts vaccinated abroad from self-isolation requirements, Contacts who have been vaccinated abroad with an MHRA approved vaccine should be exempt from the requirement to self-isolate when contacted by NHS Test and Trace., Those vaccinated abroad are recognised under travel rules, but not Test and Trace.
 
If someone who was vaccinated abroad is informed by NHS Test and Trace that they were in contact with someone who tested positive for coronavirus, they will have to self-isolate.
 
If the same vaccine was administered by the NHS, as per the rules, the individual does not have to self-isolate.
 
We believe these rules are nonsensical, inconsistent and should be changed to recognise vaccinations administered abroad.

Allow vaccinated health and social care workers to isolate at home, All UK and Irish nationals who are carers or work in the health sector, who are fully vaccinated and returning from a red list country, to self-isolate at home., We need the Government to stop requiring managed quarantine for British and Irish nationals who work within these sectors.
 
Reverse the decision with regards to Hotel Quarantine for those who work within the Health and Social Care Sectors who are returning from Red List countries and who are fully vaccinated.

Remove all African countries from the red list immediately, Since travel restrictions have been imposed on travellers entering the UK from several African countries, a number of cases of transmission of the Omicron variant, not linked to travel to South Africa, have been identified., We believe the travel restrictions are not justified by the evidence, especially when the only countries on the red list are African, when cases of the Omicron variant have been identified in several other countries.

Offer further financial support for Travel Agents and Travel Industry as a whole, Due to extremely low consumer demand for reasons of expensive testing requirements and continued uncertainty, a financial package of support should be offered to all travel agent companies, as well as the airline and travel industry as a whole., For nearly two years, the travel industry has been continually affected, meaning companies have had to close indefinitely or make large proportions of staff redundant. We must now support this sector. There is low confidence in consumers meaning income has been hugely affected across all areas of the travel industry. We stand together and demand a reasonable new financial package of support.

Vaccinated travellers from red list countries should not quarantine in hotels, UK Government should allow at least double vaccinated people arriving from red list countries to isolate in their individual houses for 10 days and taking the PCR tests on Day 2 and Day 8. The normal red list rules should then apply to unvaccinated travellers., If both double vaccinated and unvaccinated travellers are treated the same, it means covid vaccination is not effective.

Release blue print used in developing the Red list relating to Omicron strain, I want the Government to do their part in ensuring that the Omicron strain of the Covid 19 virus does not become equated with an ‘African Virus’. Remove African countries added needlessly to the Red List, and then add European countries that have earned their place in the red list!, Several articles detail  the current spread of the Omicron strain with European countries such as the Netherlands recording 14 cases, Denmark 13, Portugal 13. There has to be a rational reason why countries like these are not on the Red list and African countries such as Mozambique with 2cases, Nigeria with 3 cases have been rapidly added. The Gov.Uk Red list as at 4/12/21 has only African countries. If this is not an African disease, did not originate in Africa, WHY IS AFRICA PAYING THIS PRICE

Remove requirements for UK arrivals to enter quarantine in a managed hotel, The Government needs to stop requiring UK arrivals from red list countries into hotel quarantine. We believe is incompatible with a person's human rights to be required to pay to enter mandatory quarantine, when trying to return to their homes., Everyone has the right to liberty and security of person. By forcing individuals to enter hotel quarantine we believe the Government is depriving individuals of their right to liberty without charging them with a crime. They are also forcing the individual to pay for their own detention.

Bring back single award GCSE Science., Currently GCSE students only have the option of taking individual GCSEs for Physics, Biology and Chemistry, or a double award (taking two GCSEs) covering all the sciences. We believe students should be given the option of a single award Science GCSE., We believe requiring all students to take two or three science GCSEs reduces the time available to study other subjects, such as additional Maths, English or vocational and creative subjects. Current options provide little common ground with entry level qualifications.

A single award Science GCSE, with less content than dual or current single award GCSEs, for each science subject, could be more suitable for students of lower ability, or those who have missed school due to ill health or other reasons.

Remove Nigeria from the UK Covid travel red list, The government added Nigeria to the list of covid restricted countries following 21 cases of Omicron reported in England and was allegedly traced to Nigeria without any form of evidence. Nigeria is currently one of the No.1 safest countries in the world today because of its approach against covid19., I am sad and of the view that the decison to include Nigeria on the red list is a systematic abuse of the African people simply because Nigeria was one of the first countries in the world that introduced drastic measures to combact the spread of Covid19 and other variants. The government announced that from 4am on Tuesday 7 December 2021 anyone wishing to come to the UK will need to show a negative pre departure test (LFD or PCR) and this was a measure first introduced in Nigeria since 2020.

Hold an Inquiry into Quarantine Hotels, We want the Government to launch a public inquiry that investigates how the hotels travellers required to enter managed quarantine must use are chosen, how they are managed, the cost of this service, and the quality of service they provide, including the food provided and customer service., I am currently staying in a quarantine hotel. The food is atrocious, we cannot talk to hotel management as we are stopped by security. There is no proper avenue for complaints.

Fund free school meals for Year 3 and 4 pupils until 2024, In England, children in KS1 (Reception, Year 1 & 2) are entitled to free school meals regardless of household income.
This petition requests that this provision is extended for Years 3 and 4 for the next two academic years to compensate for the loss of access to healthy meals during lockdowns., Families have missed out on the free school meals that would have been provided during lockdowns.
Some schools had provision to collect lunches but this was not consistent and not always practical or economical to collect lunches.
For many families school meals allow their child to eat a healthy meal that they may not otherwise get, of great importance given the increase in sedentary lifestyles as a result of lockdowns.
The provision should be extended to Years 3 & 4 for the next two academic years.

Do not restrict the number of visitors care home residents can receive, Let residents live how they are meant too - by being surrounded by family and friends. They shouldn’t be having these restrictions enforced on them all the time, whilst large events and stadiums full of people can still continue., They have been isolated enough. Everyone should have the right to freedom and not have to pick between family members of who gets to see them.
 
What’s the point of vaccines, PPE, testing if relatives still can’t visit properly?
 
This must stop now. This is making the vulnerable even more vulnerable.
We want a rematch of the 2019 General Election! Boris vs Jeremy, Now that we have seen Boris and Starmer… we demand a rematch!, Make Great Britain Great again… by giving Jeremy Corbyn another shot!

Improve Covid-19 Mitigation Measures in Schools, To reduce in-school transmission:

1.Siblings of Covid positive cases must isolate
2.Daily testing and reporting for reception-y12 to ensure cases are picked up
3.Parents allowed the flexibility to homeschool for 10 days while cases are high
4.Funding for HEP air filters in classrooms, To help keep schools open safely and preserve in person learning, it is necessary that additional measures be introduced to keep children, teachers and their families safe. Without change to current rules, cases could rise in classrooms and lead to school closure and more missed school days. The new measures should decrease in-school transmission and allow more teachers & students to continue attending school. Moreover, they could reduce community transmission and reduce pressure on the NHS.

Refund UK citizens and residents required to hotel quarantine from November 2021, Fully refund managed quarantine costs (minimum £2,285) incurred by people returning to the UK from the 11 countries added to the red list from 26 November-15 December.

Affected countries: Angola, Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Nigeria, South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe, It has been determined this measure was ineffective as a measure to limit the spread of the COVID-19 Omicron variant and has been punitive for those who had to endure not only the cost of managed quarantine but the distress caused by the organisation and quality of accommodation and meals.

Exempt NHS workers who have recovered from COVID from vaccination requirements, Exempt NHS staff from vaccination requirements if they have recovered from COVID. We believe that it is a person’s immune status and not their vaccination status which is most important. , Vaccination is there to create an antibody reaction. If NHS workers can evidence that they have recovered from COVID-19, and that they have antibody reaction then this should be accepted.

If this exemption is allowed, it could prevent many much needed and valued NHS and care workers losing their jobs, which creates distress and also a national shortage.

Impose a 4-week lockdown to combat Omicron, Impose a 4-week lockdown to prevent the NHS being overwhelmed while the severity of Omicron can be properly assessed., It appears that Omicron may be more transmissible then previous strains. If it results in severe illness in a similar way to previous strains the NHS could be overwhelmed. Many hospitals are already at 94% of total capacity.
 
To prevent a situation where the NHS cannot effectively treat people a short lockdown should be imposed so that the data regarding Omicron can be assessed. Doing this now it should have the smallest amount of impact on schools and businesses due to the time of the year. Delay could result in a longer more costly lockdown.

Protect tenants from eviction during the COVID pandemic, The Government should reintroduce measures to protect tenants, along the lines of those implemented in 2020. Landlords should be required to give tenants at least six months’ notice of ending a tenancy, and all eviction proceedings should be stopped for the duration of the pandemic., The current COVID emergency has made finding and keeping accommodation difficult for many people, with limited availability and high rents in many areas.
 
The Government should ensure that tenants are protected from eviction for the duration of the pandemic.

Make it a legal requirement for courier companies to have human customer service, Make it a legal requirement for couriers like hermes to have human representation within their customer service that are easily reachable by telephone, chat or email. Obligation to respond and work with customers should be mandatory and having an automated computer response only should be banned., We have ongoing issues with hermes deliberately not delivering to our address over an internal dispute over who is responsible within their organisation to deliver our parcels as we sit on the border of 3 villages. The problem is so bad every single parcel has been 'lost' in the past 2 years. We cannot speak to anyone at hermes and through a lot of hard work on social media have found a local driver who has given us this info. As we cannot speak to anyone at hermes we cannot resolve the issue.

Do not implement a circuit breaker lockdown, This petition calls on the UK Government NOT to force the public into another Circuit Breaker Lockdown., There are reports the Cabinet is discussing another circuit breaker Lockdown. However there are a number of reasons (below) why we are calling on the Government to reject this idea.
 
1) UK daily Covid 19 related deaths have been on a downward trend 2) We believe it is too late for a lockdown to stop the spread of the Omicron variant
3) The financial and economic impact could be crippling for the beleaguered hospitality industry
4) The mental health impact on the public and especially young people could be catastrophic.

Make it illegal for under 18s to buy or own a mobile phone, With data showing a steady rise in young people experiencing mental health problems, we believe the Government should impose a legal age limit on ownership of a mobile phone, similar to age limits for addictive substances such as alcohol and tobacco., Mobile phones and young people seem to be a dangerous mix. The rise in addictive behaviour, children seeing explicit materials online, peer on peer abuse, sexting, mental health issues linked to social media, cyber bullying and peer pressure is directly linked to children using smart phones. Therefore is it time phones were given an age restriction. To own you own mobile phone a person should be required to show ID to prove they were over the age of 18.

Set up a parliamentary select committee to investigate veterinary costs., The Government to set up a parliamentary select committee to investigate the substantial increase in veterinary costs over recent years., Some increases are several 100s percent higher than inflation. The select committee should also investigate whether there is a correlation between the raise in costs and large Veterinary Firms taking over many small practices.  Many pet owners are often faced with the agonizing choice between the cost of treatment or having their much loved pet put to sleep.

Bring a motion for a Select Committee for Safeguarding Adults., Set up a Select Committee fit for purpose to investigate safeguarding adults with learning disabilities., There is something very wrong with the work practice services for Safeguarding Adults with learning disabilities, which need investigating.
